stem_en:
4.9 g of H2SO4 is dissolved in 50 mL of solution. Which are correct?
(i) the solution is 1 M
(ii) its concentration is 98000 ppm
(iii) its concentration is 9.8 × 10^4 μg/mL
stem_bn:
50 mL দ্রবণে 4.9 g H2SO4 দ্রবীভূত আছে। কোনগুলো সঠিক?
(i) দ্রবণটি 1 M
(ii) ঘনমাত্রা 98000 ppm
(iii) ঘনমাত্রা 9.8 × 10^4 μg/mL
explanation_en: 0.05 mol in 0.05 L = 1 M; 4.9 g/50 mL = 98 g/L = 98000 ppm = 98 mg/mL = 9.8 × 10^4 μg/mL, so all three agree.
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; chemistry p2 ch03; curated bilingual
